level.title: Checking level
level.summary: Chooses whether paragraphs are checked for grammar, style, or both.
level.description: auto checks grammar, and style too when the question asks for it; grammar or style checks only that; all checks both. Each level is one model call per paragraph.

confirmation.title: Confirm large checks
confirmation.summary: Controls when the tool asks before checking many paragraphs.
confirmation.description: With when_large, a check needing more model calls than the large-check limit shows an estimated time and offers a quick check or cancelling first.

large_batches.title: Large-check limit
large_batches.summary: Sets how many model calls make a check large.
large_batches.description: A check above this number of model calls asks for confirmation when confirmation is when_large.

max_model_calls.title: Maximum model calls
max_model_calls.summary: Hard limit on logical model requests in one check.
max_model_calls.description: At most this many requests are made, even when no confirmation interface exists. Includes the document brief and each grammar/style check. Unchecked paragraphs are reported as incomplete. Range: 1 to 500.

max_prompt_characters.title: Maximum prompt characters
max_prompt_characters.summary: Hard size limit for each model request, including the system prompt.
max_prompt_characters.description: Requests exceeding this total character length are not sent to the model. The document brief is optional; oversized paragraph checks are reported as incomplete, and oversized rewrites are skipped. Text is never silently truncated. Default: 16000; range: 2000 to 100000. This is a character limit, not a model token limit.

quick_paragraphs.title: Quick-check paragraphs
quick_paragraphs.summary: Sets how many paragraphs the quick option checks.
quick_paragraphs.description: The quick option offered for a large check checks only the grammar of this many paragraphs from the start of the chosen part.

chat_findings.title: Findings shown in chat
chat_findings.summary: Caps the findings listed in the chat answer.
chat_findings.description: The chat answer lists at most this many findings; the saved report in outputs/ lists all of them.
